example.name: basic_task_implementation
example.scenario: A task in tasks.md reads: "- [ ] Implement user profile API endpoint to update display name" design.md specifies the API contract with method signature, request/response schemas, and error handling requirements.

step.description: Read tasks.md and identify the task
step.approach: Parse tasks.md, find the first [ ] item
step.expected_outcome: Task identified: "Implement user profile API endpoint to update display name"

step.approach: Locate the user profile API specification in design.md
step.expected_outcome: API contract understood: PATCH /api/user/profile, request body { displayName: string }, response { success: boolean, user: User }, error 400 if invalid

step.approach: Create or modify the route handler in src/app/api/user/profile/route.ts
step.expected_outcome: Code written matching the design.md contract

step.approach: Execute npm run build and npm test
If npm run build fails, analyze error, fix, re-run
step.expected_outcome: Fix the issue without asking user
Next task identified or QA handoff triggered

example.name: verification_failure_recovery
example.scenario: npm run build fails with a TypeScript error in the newly implemented file.

step.approach: Read the error output - "Type error: Property 'displayName' does not exist on type 'User'"
step.expected_outcome: Root cause: User type in types/index.ts missing displayName property

step.approach: Add displayName?: string to the User interface in types/index.ts
Mark task [x] and proceed to next task

key_takeaways.takeaway: Fix root cause, not symptoms - the error was a missing type property, not the endpoint code
Self-sufficient recovery - no user intervention needed

example.name: qa_handoff_trigger
example.scenario: Last remaining task in tasks.md has been marked [x]. All items are now complete.

step.approach: Read tasks.md, confirm every item shows [x]
Do not attempt to review, refactor, or improve any completed work
Print exactly: "🛑 EXECUTION COMPLETE. All tasks in tasks.md are finished. Please switch Roo Code to Reviewer Mode and prompt me to begin the Kiro/Antigravity audit."

key_takeaways.takeaway: No additional text before or after the handoff message
Do not self-audit - defer to the Kiro/Antigravity audit
